text:
perf-bot: CI perf check failed: runtime/kernel-selection throughput regressed 2.6x on main (job 4451). traces: https://ci.internal/redwood/4451
mia: ack. which merge landed recently?
perf-bot: merge commit 0a1f3bd9 from PR #512 (kernel selector fallback + kv cache key tweak).
raj: assigning a bisect. can someone reproduce locally first?
olivia: I can try on my devbox (A100). what's the exact repro command?
mia: ./perf/harness --model llama-2-13b --seq 2048 --batch 4 --tokens 1024 --profile --dump-kv-stats > /tmp/run.out 2>&1
mia: baseline (before 0a1f3bd9): ~45ms/token median. after merge: ~118ms/token. KV cache hit rate fell from ~92% -> ~58% in the profile.
raj: ok start a git bisect: mark known-good commit b3f4a1c2 (from last green perf) and bad HEAD=0a1f3bd9.
olivia: running: git bisect start 0a1f3bd9 b3f4a1c2 then building and running harness at each step. will post results.
[olivia pasted a short log snippet]
```
# bisect output
Bisecting: 27 revisions left to test after this (roughly)
+ commit c7d2e56
  Author: infraeng
  Date:   2024-06-18
  Message: heuristics: prefer generic kernel fallback for small layers
```
olivia: bisect hit commit c7d2e56 (PR #498) — kernel selection heuristics change.
mia: interesting, that PR supposedly only affected tiny layers. but our runtime picks the generic kernel for attention mm on larger layers now? weird.
raj: can you run the harness with kernel dump to see choices: ./perf/harness --model ... --dump-kernel-choice > kernel_choices.txt
olivia: kernel_choices.txt shows many layers choosing generic_matmul instead of optimized_cuBLAS for attention_qk on batch=4 and seq=2048.
ken: I reproduced locally too. at c7d2e56, median token latency 115ms. at b3f4a1c2 (good) it's 47ms. run with --trace-kv shows additional KV cache misses triggered: a change to cache key composition in PR #512 causes the cache to miss more often when combined with the kernel switch.
mia: so two interacting regressions: kernel selection misclassification (PR #498) and cache-key change (PR #512). one increases per-token cost, the other increases work due to cache misses.
raj: actionable: we need a short-term revert/patch to unblock canary. options: revert c7d2e56 or tighten fallback heuristics and revert the cache-key tweak. which is smaller?
ken: revert c7d2e56 is safest and smaller surface. I can prepare a revert PR that restores previous kernel-selection thresholds and adds a regression test that asserts we pick optimized_cuBLAS for attention at batch>=2 and seq>=512 on A100-like hw.
olivia: also add a perf CI test that runs the harness for the model/seq/batch combo and fails on >1.5x regression.
mia: deploy-bot: canary rollout status?
deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused: perf regression >2x detected. auto-rollback enabled but previous canary already had degraded instances.
raj: marking as rollout blocker. @ken please prioritize. who can validate the revert locally? olivia/ken/mia?
ken: I'll run the full perf profile after I open the revert PR. will post numbers. ETA ~30m.
[~25m later]
ken: local results after revert PR applied locally: median 50ms/token, KV hit back to ~90%. test harness output snippet:
```
Model: llama-2-13b
Seq: 2048, Batch: 4
Before (bad): 118 ms/token
After (revert): 50 ms/token
KV hits: 58% -> 90%
```
ken: opening PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/523 (revert c7d2e56 + unit tests + perf CI guard)
raj: thanks. I'll queue a canary with the revert in a branch once CI passes. need one more reviewer. @mia can you review the regression test?
mia: will review in the next 10. also add a short note in the release notes about not changing kernel heuristics without perf artifacts.
olivia: after revert merged and canary promoted, let's do a staged rollout to ensure no other platforms regress.
raj: agreement. assigning follow-up: validate on p3/rtx clusters. @ken you own validation.
ken: acknowledged. will attach perf artifacts and flamegraphs to the PR.
mia: resolved for now. please keep thread updated if anything else crops up. :thumbsup:
raj: postmortem TODO: document interaction between kernel selection heuristics and KV key format; add an automated cross-check to CI that runs kernel-choice smoke for representative seq/batch combos.
perf-bot: Job 4451 annotated as "bisected -> c7d2e56; revert PR 523 opened"
